dslRule:
<!id: field.addFinalPrivateInitialized>
<!description: Adds the final modifier to private fields that are initialized at declaration and are not already final.>
<!severity: HINT>

private $Type $name = $init :: !hasModifier($name, "final")
=> private final $Type $name = $init
;;
summary: Adds the `final` modifier to private fields that are initialized at their declaration, improving immutability where appropriate.
